title: Bungie says Destiny 2 will continue and vaulted campaigns, destinations and raids will return
question: How will Destiny 2 players and content creators react to this over the first two weeks, which groups will push back and why, and is Bungie likely to keep, change or reverse the decision?

objections.text: Bungie has a history of making and breaking commitments, so players want delivery before trusting it.
No timeline or dates were given for the content's return.
A smaller studio after several layoffs may not have the resources to rebuild the content.
Restored campaigns and raids will take a lot more storage on consoles and PCs.

backdown.summary: The restoration plan stands; a later unconfirmed report says campaigns will not return until early 2028.

pushback_groups: long-time players sceptical of Bungie's record
notes: Positive case: players and creators who campaigned against the end of Destiny 2 celebrated; coverage calls it cautiously positive and no opposition to the restoration was found. The 'objections' are doubts about delivery. The PC Gamer reaction piece and the early-2028 timeline report rest on search snippets only. The announcement follows a May 2026 end-of-development decision that drew organised player pressure, so the input mentions that background.
